sample.other_case_status: unit-test assertions only; not human-adjudicated metric sample

metric_definitions.Intent Preservation: exactly matched gold slots / 6 per case: domain, source method, target method, task, direction, explicit constraints; aggregate case-level mean.
metric_definitions.Precision@5: human-labeled relevant works among first 5 original-ranked works / 5 per branch; not scored until adjudication file is completed.
metric_definitions.Direction Coverage: gold directions with >=1 human-labeled relevant result / number of gold directions; result must be tied to actual branch retrieval.
metric_definitions.Irrelevant Evidence Rate: human-labeled irrelevant works used by landscape/factual claims/RQs / all works used by those outputs; undefined with zero outputs.
metric_definitions.Claim Support Rate: human-adjudicated supported factual claims / all factual claims; exact quote substring is reported separately and is not substituted for semantic support.
metric_definitions.Latency: wall-clock milliseconds for recorded local planning/retrieval/generation stages; historic V0 latency unavailable; offline replay latency excludes API.
metric_definitions.Cost: actual billed LLM cost; no LLM calls in this run, so $0. OpenAlex free API cost is $0; limits/rate caps still apply.

Precision@5.denominator: 5 per branch with results; see human_review.csv

Direction Coverage.reason: snapshot replay is not fresh branch retrieval; manual review plus real retrieval required
